sourceData.meaningMnemonic: The <radical>nothing</radical> radical and the <kanji>nothing</kanji> kanji are exactly the same! Woah!
sourceData.readingMnemonic: <kanji>Nothing</kanji> can <reading>moo</reading> (<ja>む</ja>) quite like a cow can moo. Cows are the best at going moo. That’s a fact.
sourceData.readingInfo: Listen to this cow moo. Can you do a better moo than this moo cow? Nope.
